what: The gc-run-logs test plan omits the outside-repo guard and does not require no-mutation assertions for guard failures
scenario_or_breakage: The bash script checks repo root, larch-logs, dirty tree, and main branch before dry-run/apply mutation. The plan only says to cover dirty-tree, not-main, and missing larch-logs failures, so a Python port could still create a branch, alter files, stage, push, or open a PR before returning an error
suggested_fix: Revise python/test_gc_run_logs.py scope to cover outside-repo failure and assert outside-repo, missing-larch-logs, dirty-tree, and not-main exits make no filesystem changes and issue no checkout/add/commit/push/gh calls. Also assert dry-run makes no filesystem changes and no push or PR calls
